_: Routes the smoke and visual gates drive against the production build. Keep this in step with the app: a route here and not in the app fails the gate, and a route in the app and not here is simply not covered. Default locale is zh-TW.
_needs_api: Skipped, and the skip printed, when ROAM_API_URL is unset or down.
_states: A route whose visual coverage comes from a state spec instead of one natural screenshot. Whatever the page happens to render is not a baseline when the states are what the contract names — see shop-states.spec.ts. Smoke still drives it.
_pending: A route the product does not serve YET, with the issue that owes it. It does not fail the gate — but the moment it starts answering, the gate fails and says to clear the flag. A route nobody is required to fix is not pending, it is absent: leave it out.
